scenes.a: If you are staring at your dwindling bank account wondering how tomorrow is covered, hear this.
For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste,
neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail,
according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
Lord, we yield our meager reserves into Your hands. Sustain our household, multiply our obedience, and provide for every pressing need today.
